test_title: PYST 167: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 09 Feb, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. A sits third to the left of D. D sits to the extreme right. Only two people sit between A and F. B is an immediate neighbour of F. Only one person sits between C and D. G is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who sits to the extreme left?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) D sits to the extreme right.

2_ A sits third to the left of D. 

3) Only two people sit between A and F.

4) B is an immediate neighbour of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83db564d5aedc19f43e19923143a20e9240f1758a74beef387bb94cff7b44cff.png] 

5) Only one person sits between C and D.

6) G is not an immediate neighbour of A.

And, E will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9bfe1090b5588df46d91c79dd844c915e9fe97b8badae738b813fc9aec2be08.png] 

Here, 'F' sits to the extreme left.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
